skill.displayName: 小红书评论分析与需求挖掘

llm.summary: The skill has a clear read-only comment-analysis purpose, but it runs a mutable external npm package at runtime with the user's API key available.

dimensions.detail: Requiring node, npm, network access, and SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY is proportionate for a SocialDataX API integration, but running an unpinned npm package gives that package access to the local execution environment.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The direct CLI examples repeatedly use npx -y socialdatax-skills@latest, so the executed package can change after review and is not pinned or integrity-checked.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are mostly scoped to user-provided XHS content and returned comment data; optional pagination flags such as --all can expand collection, but they are disclosed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill does not instruct persistent memory writes, services, scheduled tasks, browser-profile access, login actions, posting, liking, commenting, or account modification.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is coherent: fetch Xiaohongshu comments or replies from user-provided note URLs or IDs and summarize themes, pain points, FAQs, and feedback.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust the SocialDataX npm package and are comfortable exposing SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY to code fetched at runtime. Prefer a pinned package version or a preinstalled reviewed CLI before using this skill in a sensitive environment.
llm.findings: [RP1] unexpected: The concern is supported by the artifact: three command examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx. Using a provider CLI is purpose-aligned, but using a mutable latest package is not necessary for the read-only comment-analysis purpose and creates supply-chain review drift.
